description: Mortgage points break-even — Should you buy discount points (or take a lender credit)? loan=, rate= (%), points= (negative = lender credit), plus rate_with_points= or reduction_per_point= (default 0.25), term_years= (30), years= you expect to keep the loan (7), point_cost_pct= (1), discount_rate= (% opportunity cost). Returns both payments, upfront cost, simple and true break-even months (true counts faster principal paydown), discounted break-even, net benefit at 3/5/7/10/15/30 years and your horizon, lifetime interest saved, and WORTH IT / MARGINAL / NOT WORTH IT (or TAKE / SKIP THE CREDIT). Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
